_note: One unit = one lesson path in five steps. Write 'God' (the Muslim view shows 'Allah'). Verses by ref only (shown from src/data/ayahs.json); hadith by id only (shown from src/data/hadith.json). 'about' lines are our own words, never a translation.

intro.muslim: Before Adam, there were the angels: beings of light who praise God without tiring. God told them He would place a successor on the earth. Watch what they asked, what they learned, and how they obeyed.
intro.curious: Before the first human, the Quran describes angels: beings of light who praise God without tiring. God told them He would place a successor on the earth. Watch what they asked, and how they obeyed.

muslim.situation: You're alone in your room and nobody will ever know if you do something you know is wrong.

options.label: Do it: nobody is watching.
options.feedback: Muslims believe someone always is. The teaching explains who the angels are and what they do.

options.label: Hold back, remembering God sees and the angels record.
options.feedback: That's what belief in the angels does: it makes you the same person in private as in public.

options.label: Do it, and tell yourself you'll make up for it later.
options.feedback: Planning to apologise doesn't change what's being done. Let's look at how the angels are described.

options.label: Get busy with something else so the urge passes.
options.feedback: A wise move. Belief in the angels adds a reason that lasts beyond the moment.

curious.situation: You're alone, and nobody will ever know if you do something you know is wrong.

options.label: Do it: nobody will know.
options.feedback: Muslims believe nothing is truly unseen. See what Islam teaches about the angels.

options.label: Hold back: you'd know, and that matters.
options.feedback: Being the same person in private as in public: that's what Muslims link with belief in the angels.

options.label: Do it, and plan to make up for it later.
options.feedback: Planning to make up for it doesn't change what's being done. See how Islam describes the angels.

options.label: Distract yourself until it passes.
options.feedback: A wise move. Muslims add a deeper reason: someone is always aware.

heading.muslim: What God teaches about the angels
heading.curious: What Islam teaches about the angels

quran.about: God tells the angels He will place a successor on the earth, and they ask how one who may spread corruption could be chosen, while they praise Him.
God teaches Adam the names of things, and the angels admit they know only what God has taught them.
The angels bow to Adam at God's command, all except Iblis, who was not one of them.
Angels never disobey what God commands them, and do what they are told.
Over every person are noble angels who record, and they know what people do.

hadith.about: The angels were created from light, the jinn from fire, and Adam from earth.
Belief in the angels is one of the six pillars of faith.

insights.text: Angels are created from light (Muslim 2996) and never disobey God (66:6). Some are named in the Quran: Jibril, who brought revelation (2:97), and Mika'il (2:98). Others take souls at death (32:11) or record what people do (82:10-12).
Iblis was not an angel but a jinn (18:50). That's why he could refuse; the angels, by nature, obey.

check.q: What did the angels ask when told about a successor on earth?
options: How one who might spread corruption could be chosen, while they praised God
check.why: They asked how one who might spread corruption and shed blood could be chosen (2:30).

check.q: What did the angels say when Adam knew the names?
options: They knew only what God had taught them
check.why: Glory be to You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us (2:32).

check.q: What are angels created from, according to the hadith?
check.why: The angels were created from light, the jinn from smokeless fire, and Adam from clay.
18:50 says Iblis was one of the jinn, which is why he could disobey.

check.q: What does 82:10-12 say some angels do?
check.why: Noble angels record, and they know what people do.

reflection.muslim: If you remembered the angels recording beside you all day tomorrow, what would you say or do differently?
reflection.curious: Would you act differently if you knew everything you did was being written down? What does that say about you?
